name: Audit published workflows missing an error workflow

parameters.content:
## Audit published workflows missing an error workflow

### How it works

This workflow audits published n8n workflows to find any that do not have an error workflow configured. It can run manually or on a Monday morning schedule, loads configurable exclusions and limits, retrieves published workflows, checks for missing error workflow settings, then posts a Slack digest only when there is something to report.

### Setup steps

- Configure the n8n credential used by the "Get Published Workflows" node so it can list workflows from the target n8n instance.
- Update the "Configuration" node with the correct n8nBaseUrl, excludedTags, excludedWorkflowIds, and maxWorkflowsListed values.
- Configure the Slack credential and target channel in the "Send Slack Digest" node.
- Review or adjust the schedule in "Every Monday Morning" if the audit should run at a different cadence.

### Customization

Adjust the exclusion lists to ignore known-safe workflows or tags, and edit the Slack message formatting code if you want a different digest layout or severity wording.

## Start and configure

Manual and scheduled triggers feed into a shared configuration node that defines the n8n instance, exclusions, and listing limits for the audit.

## Audit published workflows

Retrieves published workflows from n8n, identifies workflows without an error workflow configured, and formats the findings into Slack-ready markdown.

## Report audit result

Checks whether the audit found unprotected workflows, sends a Slack digest when needed, or ends cleanly when all workflows are protected.
